source.method: Figma MCP screenshots + get_design_context + read-only Plugin API geometry, instance identity, visibility and recursive variable aliases

observations.note: All ten labels, including Current, use local color/text/default #1C1C1C at Pretendard Regular16/24. Root gap0; separators own px8. Current remains noninteractive aria-current=page despite identical label color.

Ten items use original BreadcrumbItem2372:36927; last item in each variant has separator Boolean=false and no rendered separator subtree. Four slash instances use original2372:36931 rather than the copied2427:25424; four arrows use2427:25428.

Original slash source uses an external semantic variable; displayed slash instances override it with local color/text/default-subtler. Equal paint/geometry does not imply equal variable IDs or product adoption.

get_design_context generated slash text for the arrow Breadcrumb, while its screenshot and read-only Plugin API both show arrow vector instances. Use measured instances and the exact separator asset; generated slash code is not a verified mapping.

Only separator=slash/arrow are provided for Breadcrumb. Dash exists only on the standalone separator. No TextButton/IconButton instance, overflow trigger, menu, hover/pressed/focused/disabled or dark rendering is supplied.
Five sample labels and widths315/313.22998 are not fixed item counts, product widths or routing API. Component-set purple outline/radius5 and canvas placement are authoring decoration.
